slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
“楚风，你放肆，我乃是太子妃，你竟敢……”
额？
耳边传来的怒斥声，让楚风眼中露出一丝迷茫。
他不是在阿尔卑斯山引爆了c4，和那群追杀自己的王牌特工同归于尽了么？
怎么没死？
而且，身下似乎还压着一具女人的身体。
随之，一股无名的火焰猛地从他小腹窜起，瞬间席卷全身，血液都仿佛要燃烧起来。
“被下药了！”
楚风瞬间反应过来。
作为曾经的暗黑世界王者，他对这套再熟悉不过，但这药性猛烈得超乎想象，正疯狂吞噬着他的理智，让他只想发泄。
他低头看向身下的绝色美人，最后一丝理智瞬间荡然无存，没有任何犹豫，直接就猛地亲了上去。
很快，女子的怒斥声便化作了阵阵诱人的嘤咛声。
（接下来的三千字剧情请大家自行想象）
……
随着体内的药性彻底消退，楚风才得以冷静下来，重新审视眼前的一切。
“艹，我竟然穿越了！”
当楚风吸收完脑海中凭空多出的那股庞大记忆后，他忍不住低声骂道。
没错，他穿越了。
在他和那群王牌特工同归于尽后，灵魂穿越到了这个玄幻世界，附身在一个和他同名同姓的家伙身上。
而他这一世的身份……

大乾皇朝，镇北王府世子，楚风。
一个……人嫌狗憎，声名狼藉的顶级纨绔！
爷爷，楚天渊，大乾皇朝元老，为大乾开疆扩土，立下赫赫战功，被先皇赐封镇北王，成为大乾第一位异姓王！
父亲，楚狂龙，大乾第一战神，镇北大将军，手握重兵，镇守北境，曾屠戮北方蛮族三十万大军，麾下的镇北军威震四方。
姐姐，楚清歌，顶级宗门天剑山千年不遇的剑道奇才，被宗门老祖誉为拥有“剑仙之姿”
，未来成就不可限量。
他还有两个叔叔，皆是位列将军之职，手握重权！
这背景，硬到令人发指。
可偏偏原主，是个文不成武不就的废物点心，
吃喝玩乐样样精通，正经事一件不干，勾栏听曲更是家常便饭。
京城百姓提起他这个镇北王府世子，无不摇头叹息，公认的大乾第一纨绔！
“妈的！”
楚风又低骂一声，揉着刺痛的太阳穴，“老子前世好歹也是纵横西方暗黑世界，被十国悬赏十亿美金的冥王，竟然穿到这么个废物身上！”
最主要的是，刚一穿越就被人下药算计，简直是奇耻大辱！
楚风深吸一口气，压下心中的烦躁，再次看向那个被他蹂躏得已经昏死过去的女人。
此女的身份信息，瞬间在他脑海中浮现。
太子妃，苏幼微。
content_en:
"Chu Feng, you are so presumptuous, I am the Crown Princess, how dare you..."
Um?
The angry scolding in his ears made Chu Feng's eyes show a hint of confusion.
Didn't he detonate C4 in the Alps and die together with the group of ace agents who were chasing him?
Why didn't you die?
Moreover, there seemed to be a woman's body underneath him.
Then, an unknown flame suddenly shot up from his lower abdomen, sweeping across his body in an instant, and his blood seemed to be on fire.
"Drugged!"
Chu Feng reacted instantly.
As the former king of the dark world, he was very familiar with this method, but the potency of this medicine was beyond imagination, and it was eating away at his sanity crazily, making him just want to vent.
He lowered his head to look at the stunning beauty beneath him, and the last trace of reason disappeared in an instant. Without any hesitation, he kissed her fiercely.
Soon, the woman's angry scolding turned into waves of seductive squeals.
(Please imagine the next three thousand words of the plot)
…
As the medicinal properties in his body completely subsided, Chu Feng was able to calm down and re-examine everything in front of him.
"Fuck, I actually traveled through time!"
After Chu Feng absorbed the huge memory that appeared out of thin air in his mind, he couldn't help but cursed in a low voice.
Yes, he traveled through time.
After he died together with the group of ace agents, his soul traveled to this fantasy world and possessed a guy with the same name and surname as him.
And his identity in this life...
In the Daqian Dynasty, the prince of Zhenbei Palace was Chu Feng.
A... a top-notch dandy who is hated by everyone and has a notorious reputation!
Grandpa, Chu Tianyuan, was a veteran of the Daqian Dynasty. He opened up and expanded the territory of Daqian and made great military exploits. He was granted the title of Prince of Zhenbei by the late emperor and became the first king of a different surname in Daqian!
His father, Chu Kuanglong, was the first god of war in Daqian and the general of Zhenbei. He held heavy troops and guarded the northern border. He once slaughtered an army of 300,000 northern barbarians. The Zhenbei Army under his command was powerful in all directions.
Sister, Chu Qingge, a swordsman prodigy rarely seen in thousands of years in Tianjian Mountain, the top sect, was praised by the ancestors of the sect as having "the appearance of a swordsman"
, future achievements are limitless.
He also has two uncles, both of whom are generals and hold great power!
This background is outrageously tough.
But the original owner was a useless snack who was incompetent in both writing and martial arts.
He is proficient in eating, drinking and having fun, and does nothing serious. Listening to music is a daily routine.
When the people in the capital mentioned him, the eldest son of Zhenbei Palace, they all shook their heads and sighed. He was recognized as the number one dandy in Daqian!
"Damn it!"
Chu Feng cursed again and rubbed his stinging temples, "In my previous life, I also roamed the dark world of the West, and Pluto, who was offered a reward of one billion dollars by ten countries, actually penetrated such a waste!"
The most important thing is that being drugged and plotted as soon as you time travel is simply a shame and humiliation!
Chu Feng took a deep breath, suppressed the irritation in his heart, and looked again at the woman who had been ravaged by him until she passed out.
This woman's identity information instantly appeared in his mind.
Crown Princess, Su Youwei.
